newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources launches $3.5 billion bid for ADT.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources launches $3.5 billion bid for ADT.

text.p: Western Resources Inc. said Wednesday it bid $3.5 billion to buy the rest of ADT Ltd , the largest electronic security firm in North America.

The bid follows Republic Industries Inc.'s failed $5 billion bid to take over ADT in September, which was terminated due to a sharp drop in Republic's share price that lowered the value of the proposed merger.
